Q5651.reason: An as-is clause disclaims implied warranties of quality, while the advertised 1964 description remains an express warranty that the 1968 car breached.

Q5672.reason: Self-defense is a justification that makes the killing lawful, so there is no murder for which the instigator can be derivatively liable.

Q8537.reason: The concept is separated from justification so that a definition of punishment stays value-neutral and does not settle the moral question.
